rows.grounds: Qualifies the subtle aspect of mahāmāyā introduced in the preceding division.
Names the first principle in the series; first member of a compound with ādi.
Indicates a series starting from kalā; second member of the compound kalā-ādi.
Denotes the set of principles beginning with kalā.
Expresses non-differentiation; first member of compound with svarūpiṇī.
Predicates the essential nature of the subtle aspect as undifferentiated.
